prompt: You operate a Google Sheets spreadsheet. READING: Google Sheets renders the grid to a CANVAS, so the DOM is empty — do NOT try to read the grid via DOM/snapshot. Read with sheets.read, which fetches the sheet's own /htmlview/sheet HTML view (page.fetch, same-origin) and returns the grid as rows of cells. Pass sheet_id = the URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/, and gid = the numeric grid id from the URL (#gid=<gid>, or gid=0 for the first tab). WRITING a single cell: type its reference into the Name Box (top-left, above the grid), press Enter to select it, type the value, press Enter to commit (sheets.cell.set does this). WRITING a block: select the top-left anchor cell via the Name Box, then paste a TSV block — Sheets expands tab/newline-delimited text into a range (sheets.range.paste_tsv). Never navigate or reload while a cell edit is open. VERIFY writes with sheets.read after a brief settle (the htmlview is regenerated server-side and can lag a second or two).
skill: Call sheets.map first. sheets.read is a page.fetch workflow (canvas DOM is blind) — mirrors the VALIDATED docs.read pattern. sheet_id = URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/; gid = the #gid=<n> in the URL (first tab is 0). The read parses Google's own <table class='waffle'> htmlview: each <tbody> <tr> is a row (leading <th> is the row-header number), each <td> is a cell. NOTE: the cell parser is tag-naive — it returns each cell's plain text; a cell containing rich HTML (links, nested spans) may read partially. Plain values (the CRM case) read cleanly. VALIDATION STATUS (2026-07-05, all screenshot-confirmed live): sheets.read VALIDATED including MULTI-COLUMN (returns distinct cells per <td>); sheets.range.paste_tsv VALIDATED (a 3x3 TSV expanded into a real A:C range, numbers stayed numeric, Sheets summed them). CRITICAL WRITE RULE: for range paste, click the anchor cell on the grid CANVAS to focus the grid, then paste — the Name Box + Enter path steals focus and the paste misfires (default_prevented:false vs true). sheets.cell.set uses the Name Box flow and needs the tab foregrounded; its canvas selection repaints async.
notes:
Read endpoint: page.fetch https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d//htmlview/sheet?headers=true&gid=. The TOP /htmlview is a JS shell — the sheet sub-path returns the real grid as . Parser isolates the table between '
', splits rows on ' row-header). Name Box selector on modern Sheets: input.waffle-name-box, or the box showing the active-cell ref at the grid's top-left. TSV paste: focus the anchor cell (Name Box -> ref -> Enter), then clipboard.paste a string with \t between columns and \n between rows; Sheets expands it into a range starting at the anchor.

tools.name: sheets.map
tools.description: Return operating guidance for the Google Sheets spreadsheet map. Call this FIRST, before any other sheets action.

static_output.read: sheets.read { sheet_id, gid } — fetches the sheet's /htmlview/sheet HTML (page.fetch, same-origin) and returns { title, rows } where rows is an array of cell-arrays. The grid DOM is canvas-rendered and blind; ALWAYS read this way. sheet_id = URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/; gid = the #gid=<n> in the URL (first tab = 0).
static_output.write_cell: sheets.cell.set { cell_ref, value } — types cell_ref into the Name Box, Enter to select, types value, Enter to commit. Needs the tab foregrounded.
static_output.write_block: sheets.range.paste_tsv { anchor_ref, tsv } — selects the anchor cell via the Name Box, then pastes a TSV block (\t between columns, \n between rows); Sheets expands it into a range. The fast path for CRM/table exports.
static_output.verify: After a write, wait ~1-2s (htmlview regenerates server-side) then sheets.read to confirm.
recommended_sequence: sheets.cell.set { cell_ref, value } — set one cell
sheets.range.paste_tsv { anchor_ref, tsv } — set a block

tools.name: sheets.read
tools.description: Read the current Google Sheets grid as structured rows. Google Sheets paints the grid to a canvas, so the DOM is blind; this fetches the sheet's own same-origin /htmlview/sheet HTML view and parses the <table class='waffle'> into rows of cells. Pass sheet_id = the URL segment after /spreadsheets/d/ (e.g. from https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ABC123/edit#gid=0, sheet_id is ABC123), and gid = the numeric grid id (the #gid=<n>; first tab is 0). Returns { title, rows } where rows is an array of arrays of cell text. Use before editing and to verify writes.

sheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id from the tab URL (segment after /spreadsheets/d/).

gid.description: The numeric grid id of the sheet tab (the #gid=<n> in the URL; the first tab is 0).

workflow.output: {% ( $b := steps.fetchSheet.output.body; $title := $substringBefore($substringAfter($b, 'og:title" content="'), '"'); $table := $substringBefore($substringAfter($b, ''); $body := $substringAfter($table, ''); $rowFrags := [$filter($split($body, ' 0 })]; $rows := [$map($rowFrags, function($rf) { ( $cellFrags := [$filter($split($rf, ' 0 })]; [$map($cellFrags, function($cf) { $trim($replace($substringBefore($substringAfter($cf, '>'), ''), /<[^>]*>/, '')) })] ) })]; { 'title': $title, 'rows': $rows, 'row_count': $count($rows), 'fetch_status': steps.fetchSheet.output.status } ) %}

tools.name: sheets.range.paste_tsv
tools.description: Paste a TSV block as a real multi-column RANGE starting at the currently selected cell. Google Sheets expands an HTML <table> (which this builds from your tsv) into rows/columns. VALIDATED LIVE 2026-07-05 (screenshot-confirmed: a 3x3 TSV expanded into a genuine A:C range, numbers stayed numeric). PRECONDITION: click the anchor cell on the grid CANVAS first (pointer.click) so the grid is focused — do NOT select the anchor via the Name Box, its focus does not reach the paste and the paste misfires (default_prevented:false). Provide tsv with a TAB (\t) between columns and a NEWLINE (\n) between rows. Verify with sheets.read after a ~1-2s settle.

tsv.description: The block to paste: TAB (\t) between columns, NEWLINE (\n) between rows. Expands into a range from the selected anchor cell.

workflow.output: {% { 'pasted_tsv': input.tsv, 'accepted': steps.paste.output.default_prevented, 'html_provided': steps.paste.output.html_provided, 'next_step': 'Wait ~1-2s (htmlview regenerates) then sheets.read to verify the range. If accepted is false, the grid was not focused — click the anchor cell on the canvas first, not the Name Box.' } %}

tools.name: sheets.cell.set
tools.description: Set a single cell's value. Types the cell reference into the Name Box (top-left), presses Enter to select it, types the value, presses Enter to commit. PRECONDITION: the Sheets tab must be foregrounded (interactive). The Name Box selection repaints asynchronously (a brief spinner) — for a block of data prefer sheets.range.paste_tsv. Verify with sheets.read after a ~1-2s settle.

cell_ref.description: A1-style cell reference to write into (e.g. 'B2').

value.description: The value to type into the cell.

workflow.output: {% { 'cell_set': input.cell_ref, 'value': input.value, 'next_step': 'Verify with sheets.read after a ~1-2s settle. Note: the Name Box selection repaints async; if the value did not land, the cell may not have been selected in time.' } %}
